faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.question1: How much can I save with solar panels?
faq.answer1: Savings vary based on your energy consumption, system size, and sunlight exposure. Our calculator provides an initial estimate, and we offer detailed site assessments.
faq.question2: What is the lifespan of a solar panel system?
faq.answer2: Most solar panels come with a 25-year performance warranty, and systems can last even longer with proper maintenance.
faq.question3: Do solar panels work on cloudy days?
faq.answer3: Yes, solar panels can still generate electricity on cloudy days, though their output will be lower than on bright sunny days. Our systems are designed considering local weather patterns.
